verdict.rationale: Drata documents the building blocks of a compliance program inside the product itself: a Policy Center and policy versioning, controls mapped to framework requirements, an evidence library, monitoring tests, and an audits API. A community thread ties Drata deployments to companies pursuing a SOC 2 audit. However, no first-party evidence names SOC 2, Type I vs Type II workflows, prebuilt Trust Services Criteria controls, SOC 2 policy templates, or auditor evidence requests. Missing for 10: explicit SOC 2 framework coverage, Type I and Type II audit workflows, prebuilt Trust Services controls, required SOC 2 policy templates, built-in evidence request handling, independent corroboration of end-to-end SOC 2 delivery.
